visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tight close-up shot of a square stainless steel pan resting on a lit gas stove burner. A single fried egg with a bright orange yolk sits in the center of the pan, surrounded by perfectly cooked, non-stuck whites. A metal spatula enters the frame from the right, effortlessly sliding underneath the egg to demonstrate its mobility. In the blurred background, another similar square pan is visible on a adjacent burner. (2) A male narrator with short black hair, wearing a light grey t-shirt, appears in a domestic kitchen setting. He is standing in front of a stainless steel range hood and holding the handle of the square pan, tilting it toward the camera. His facial expression is neutral yet focused as he uses hand gestures to emphasize his points. The kitchen lighting is bright and even, highlighting the reflective surfaces of the cookware and appliances. (3) An extreme close-up focuses on the interior surface of the pan. Several small droplets of water are dropped onto the hot metal, where they immediately form into perfect spheres and skitter across the surface without evaporating, demonstrating the Leidenfrost effect. The pan's surface shows slight discoloration and oil residue from previous use, providing a realistic cooking context. Yellow and white captions appear at the bottom center. (4) A hand is seen pouring a thin stream of clear cooking oil from a white plastic dispenser bottle into the corner of the hot square pan. The pan is then picked up and tilted in various directions, showing the oil flowing rapidly across the surface with the low viscosity of water. This visual evidence supports the narrator's claim about the pan reaching the optimal temperature for non-stick cooking. (5) The narrator cracks a raw egg into the oiled pan, and it immediately begins to sizzle and bubble as the whites set. He uses the metal spatula to move the egg around freely, proving it does not adhere to the stainless steel. After flipping the egg and showing the golden-brown crust, he slides it onto a square metal plate held in his other hand. He then holds both the pan and the plate to the camera for a final comparison.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male narrator speaking clearly and informatively in Traditional Chinese. His tone is instructional as he explains the properties of the pan. In the background, a light and upbeat acoustic guitar melody plays at a moderate tempo, providing a positive atmosphere. High-frequency sizzling sounds of an egg frying are distinctly heard, overlapping with the narration. (2) As the scene transitions, a mechanical clicking sound signifies the gas stove igniting, followed by a low, consistent hiss of the flame. The narrator continues his explanation, maintaining a steady and enunciated speech rate. The background music remains constant in volume, sitting comfortably below the level of the primary vocal track to ensure clarity. (3) During the water droplet test, subtle skittering and popping sounds are audible as the water hits the hot metal surface. These delicate acoustic transients highlight the physical demonstration. The narrator's pitch is stable, reflecting confidence and expertise. The BGM maintains its major mode, reinforcing the helpful nature of the content. (4) A distinct liquid pouring sound occurs as oil is added to the pan, accompanied by the narrator's description of the oil's behavior. The metallic clinking of a spatula against the stainless steel pan occurs intermittently, providing percussive accents to the audio track. The signal-to-noise ratio remains high, with very little background interference from the room environment. (5) The audio concludes with the narrator summarizing the pan's construction benefits. The loud, percussive crack of an eggshell is followed by a fresh, vigorous sizzling sound as it begins to cook. The spatula makes several scraping noises against the pan before the BGM fades out along with the narrator's final words, bringing the instructional piece to a professional close.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Demonstration -> Scientific Explanation -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on how to achieve a non-stick effect using a stainless steel pan by demonstrating the proper heating and oiling techniques (the Leidenfrost effect). It also serves as a product showcase to explain the superior heat conduction of a 3-layer stainless and aluminum composite construction compared to single-layer cookware.
